title: Approved genSkill Plan
description: Reference shape only. This schema is NOT wired into any runtime validation — the authoritative validator is scripts/generate-skill.cjs (see validatePlan / normalizeSkills). It exists to document the two accepted plan shapes for human readers and the plan reviewer. A plan is valid in one of two shapes: a multi-skill plan with a skills[] array (the normal case), or a legacy single-action plan with a flat steps[]. Do NOT require steps[] on a multi-skill plan — sub-skill workflow detail is authored later in writing-skills, not in the plan.

skills.description: Multi-skill shape. When present and non-empty, the plan is rendered as one skill per entry, ordered by the produces/consumes DAG. inputs_needed and steps are NOT required at the top level in this shape.

produces_shape.description: Optional hint string giving the field shape of `produces` (e.g. "{ date, resting_hr, steps }"). Not enforced; used by writing-skills to align producer output with consumer inputs and by the plan reviewer to check data-contract consistency.

inputs_needed.description: Required ONLY on a legacy single-action plan (no skills[]).

steps.description: Required ONLY on a legacy single-action plan (no skills[]). Never present on a multi-skill plan.
